name: OkTex Pipeline
researcher_notes: No existing roster row matches (checked names, other names, ONEOK and Oklahoma rows). OkTex Pipeline Company, L.L.C. is a real, operating FERC-regulated interstate system owned by ONEOK. The operator page says it runs south from interconnects with ONEOK Gas Transportation and Oklahoma Natural Gas to facilities in Texas, New Mexico and Mexico, and gives no mileage. Federal Register notices from 2000 and 2018 describe only small discrete segments (for example 52.5 miles of 20-inch pipe in Hemphill County, Texas and Roger Mills, Custer and Dewey Counties, Oklahoma, and 1.88 miles in Beckham and Wheeler Counties). No source found that states a total system length, diameter or capacity. It is a set of discrete segments, not one defined line. Without a sourced length of at least 25 km it fails the length rule. It could become a new row, or several segment rows, if a FERC Form 2 or tariff map gives segment lengths. Owner name in team style would be OkTex Pipeline Co (no close existing entity; parent ONEOK Inc already in the tracker). Not checked: FERC Form 2 filings and the EIA pipeline segment data.
